messages:
mira: FYI rolled the conditional KMS audit-logging policy to prod ~07:05 and we're seeing gpu-provisioner instances stuck in 'initializing'. Keystore errors in the logs saying 'decrypt timeout'.
jordan: seeing a 5xx spike from keystore-proxy, provisioning latency is 8x on the warmup path. nodes failing to reach Ready.
deploy-bot: policy-applier: applied 'org/audit-log-kms-conditional' -> prod at 3112223320 by alyssa.
alyssa: This was intentional for compliance — we needed envelope encryption for audit exports. Don't want to roll back without traceability.
sam: Understood, but app SLOs are broken. Can we do a short mitigation window? Options: 1) rollback, 2) enable local data-key caching in keystore-proxy, 3) route logs to SSE-S3 temporarily.
mira: Proposal: rollback for 30m, create a scoped service principal + KMS keypolicy tweak, then reapply with caching and rate limits. Rollback buys ops time.
jordan: Confirmed. If we rollback, we'll monitor provisioning and run a targeted canary. Also recommend a quick config change in keystore-proxy: cache data keys for short TTL. Example config:
```
keystore_proxy:
  dkm_cache_enabled: true
  dkm_cache_ttl_seconds: 300
  kms_retry_backoff_ms: 200
  kms_max_retries: 5
```
alyssa: Cache TTL helps but we need to ensure audit integrity. If logs are delayed/queued we must preserve ordering and signatures. Also we should avoid plaintext S3 unless it's SSE/KMS protected.
keystore-bot: metrics: keystore-proxy QPS 430 -> 1200 after policy rollout, error rate up 18%.
sam: For the temporary path: route audit stream to private S3 with SSE-S3 (no KMS) so provisioning isn't blocked, then reingest/encrypt later when KMS is back onpath. We'll annotate those objects for compliance review.
mira: OK rolling back now. @deploy-bot please revert to 'org/audit-log-default' and open rollback PR with timestamps and rationale.
deploy-bot: revert initiated: 'org/audit-log-default' -> prod, status: in-progress (patch 312).
jordan: Staging confirms provisioning success within 2min after revert, prod warmup shows nodes coming online again. Monitoring for 30m.
alyssa: I'll open a compliance ticket to document the rollback and the reapply plan. Reapply checklist: key policy update, limited principal, caching, rate-limiter, and test harness for cold-start spike.
sam: Also add token bucket rate-limiter on keystore-proxy to smooth bursts from warmpool. Should reduce KMS QPS spikes.
mira: :thumbsup: thanks. After we stabilize, let's schedule a postmortem and include cost estimate for extra KMS calls and S3 reingest.
keystore-bot: alert cleared at 3112223465, error-rate down to baseline.
mira: closing thread, will follow up with PR links + compliance ticket id.
